breakdown.description: The boundary condition of fixedValue (0 0.1 0) is set at outlet, but it should be the inlet.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly specified several boundary conditions for the 'outlet' when they should have been for the 'inlet'. The ground truth correctly assigns these conditions to the 'inlet'. The generated specification repeated the user's error, stating 'At the outlet boundary, the velocity of air is a fixedValue (0 0.1 0) m/s' and so on, instead of correcting it to the 'inlet'.
